```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw <- read_csv("../BES-2017-f2f-gender-fb-tw.csv")
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw, aes(x = Gender)) +
  geom_bar()
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw, aes(x = Use_Facebook)) +
  geom_bar()
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw,
       aes(x = Gender, fill = Use_Facebook)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```
```{r}
gender_facebook_table <- table(
  BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw$Gender,
  BES_2017_f2f_gender_fb_tw$Use_Facebook
)

gender_facebook_table
```
```{r}
chi_result <- chisq.test(gender_facebook_table)

chi_result
chi_result$expected
```
